g.text: Screenshot-only GUI agent that learns an action model of the application it automates
web app in Chromium (Playwright) or the desktop (PyAutoGUI)
e.g. the Visual Function Lab apps
gemini.py · key rotation, shared rate limiter
Agent loop · agent.py (one perceive → learn → decide → act cycle per step)
pixels + URL only (no DOM, no accessibility tree)
mouse and keyboard events at pixel coordinates
Learning and planning, no LLM calls
